svg.title: The rendering engine
svg.desc: The video's timeline is cut into parts. An edit lands on parts 3 and 4, so only they render again; the cache keeps the other six. Two other videos render their own changed parts at the same time on the same computer. The browser plays the new version while it renders, with the rendered part of the bar staying ahead of the playhead.
svg.text: An edit re-renders only its parts. Several videos render at once.
